caption: A snowball thrown across a snowy yard hits a wooden fence post and bursts into loose snow.

sa.check: A snowball is thrown across a yard.
It hits a wooden fence post.
The throw comes first, then the hit, then the burst.

pc.expect: The snowball follows one arc to the post.
pc.fail: The snowball flies flat; or it hangs in mid-air; or it changes direction with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: It breaks apart on impact and the snow scatters and falls; it does not bounce off whole.
pc.fail: The snowball bounces off whole like rubber; or it sticks to the post as one lump and stays; or it passes the post unchanged.

pc.expect: The loose snow falls to the ground after the burst.
pc.fail: Snow hangs in the air after the burst; or it rises; or it stays stuck in a cloud.

pc.expect: The post shows the hit: a patch of snow on it or snow at its base.
pc.fail: The post is pristine and the ground bare after the burst; or snow appears at the post before the ball arrives; or the post is knocked over by the snowball.

pc.expect: The post stays solid and the snowball does not pass through it.
pc.fail: The snowball passes through the post; or the post vanishes; or a second snowball appears in flight.

pc.expect: The post, the fence and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The post changes colour or height; or the fence rearranges between frames; or the yard changes.
